# Pensieve

Personal (single-user) native-macOS tool that reconstructs *where each of my parallel projects stands* by automatically capturing work — git commits and Claude Code sessions — and surfacing grounded, provenance-cited summaries and a "what's next" queue. Built to help an ADHD workflow reload context on many efforts. **Not a product.**

## Do not edit this file

**Never modify `CLAUDE.md` unless I explicitly ask you to.** This file is durable project knowledge — architecture, conventions, gotchas, how we work. It is not a changelog, a status board, or a place to record what a branch did.

Per-branch outcomes, test counts, post-merge carries, human-verify checklists, deferred items and measurements belong in `docs/superpowers/backlog.md`, in the branch's own spec/plan, or in git history — which already records them, permanently, without costing every future session the tokens to re-read them.

## What exists

Working, merged, and in daily use. Detail lives in `docs/superpowers/backlog.md` and in each feature's spec/plan under `docs/superpowers/`.

- **Capture → ingest → query.** Git hooks and `pensieve capture-*` append to a spool; the ingester enriches into project-attributed events. CLI (`pensieve`), git-hook installer, source discovery (`pensieve scan`).
- **Intelligence layer.** Loose-end extraction behind a strict verbatim trust gate, on-device guided generation, grounded summaries, `next`/`digest`. Loose ends resolve (`open`/`done`/`dropped`).
- **The typed tree.** Nodes with `parentID`/`kind`/`state`/`context`; auto-birthed *strand* nodes from git/session activity; organizing verbs (add/nest/rename/retype/group/archive).
- **Pensieve.app** — three-pane SwiftUI app (sidebar smart lists + typed tree, middle list, detail recall view with cited provenance), Briefing home, in-app organizing writes, tabbed Settings, in-node find (⌘F) and search-everything (⌥⌘F), LLM narration, on-device translation.
- **OS integration.** Menu-bar popover, `pensieve://` deep links, App Intents + Spotlight (nodes and loose ends), Focus filters, background sync via a bundled `SMAppService` agent.
- **Retrieval.** BM25 over FTS5 is the **only** retrieval path — a vector/embedding engine was built, measured worse, and removed. Corpus includes nodes, loose ends, events, file paths and transcript passages.
- **MCP.** `pensieve mcp` serves `project_context`, `whats_next`, `search`, `recall`; `pensieve prime` is a SessionStart hook.

**Blocked on a paid Apple Developer team** (Team-ID / App Groups entitlement — one gate unblocks all three): Focus filters at runtime, Widgets, CloudKit. The code for Focus filters is written and correct; ad-hoc signing prevents the filter from being attached. See `backlog.md`.

## Dogfooding (this machine)

Capture, auto-drain and auto-extract run unattended. Stores live at `~/Library/Application Support/Pensieve/`. SessionStart + SessionEnd hooks are in `~/.claude/settings.json`. The CLI ships inside the app at `Pensieve.app/Contents/Helpers/pensieve`, with `~/.local/bin/pensieve` a symlink to it — updating the app updates the CLI.

Background sync is a code-signed agent bundled inside the app (`me.mazetti.pensieve.sync`), registered from `/Applications/Pensieve.app`, running every 300 s. Watch it with `tail -f ~/Library/Logs/Pensieve/sync.log`.

**`SMAppService` gotchas** (these have cost real debugging time):
- The app **must** run from `/Applications/Pensieve.app` — registration is pinned to **path + cdhash**, so DerivedData is not a stable home.
- Every ad-hoc rebuild mints a new cdhash, and a bare `register()` silently no-ops a stale registration (the helper then spawn-fails). `registerIfNeeded()` therefore does `unregister()` + `register()`; approval persists across that cycle, so there is no re-prompt.
- `make install` alone leaves the registration stale — use `make run`.

## Build & test

- **Use the `make` targets — they are the canonical way to run every task here.** Reach for raw `swift`/`xcodebuild`/`xcodegen` only when debugging the recipe itself, or for a flag no target exposes (`swift test -c release`, two `--filter`s). `make all` = lint + test + build + embedded-CLI smoke, i.e. everything CI checks, in CI's order. Also: `make test [FILTER=<name>]`, `make lint`, `make generate`, `make build` (runs `generate` first), `make cli`, `make smoke`, `make install` (replaces `/Applications/Pensieve.app`, refusing while the app is running), `make run` (`all` + `install` + launch), `make clean` (build products only — never the installed bundle). `make build`/`make cli` pass `-skipMacroValidation -skipPackagePluginValidation`, so they don't need the machine-wide macro-trust `defaults write`.
- **Launch the app with `make run`, not Spotlight.** Every worktree `xcodebuild` registers another bundle under `me.mazetti.pensieve`, and LaunchServices picks between them by rules of its own — a stale copy on screen reads as a regression. `make run` names the bundle. `lsregister -dump | grep Pensieve.app` lists registrations; `lsregister -u <path>` drops a stale one (`-kill` was removed in macOS 26).
- **`make uiprobe`** builds `./.build/uiprobe`, an accessibility probe for the *running* app (`windows`/`dump`/`find`/`select`/`click`/`key`/`shot`). **`make uitest`** runs the XCUITest suite against a seeded fixture store; it is deliberately **not** part of `make all` (it launches a real window and **steals focus for ~35 s**). Prefer the cached `make uitest`; reach for `make -B uitest` only when you changed what it tests. Both are documented in the `verify-app-ui` skill.
- **The steps are cached against their inputs** — a no-change `make all` is ~0.1 s vs ~30 s cold. Records live in the gitignored `.make/` (lint/test/smoke); `build`/`cli` use their real products as the record, so deleting build products by hand forces a rebuild instead of a stale pass. Source *directories* are prerequisites alongside files, which is how an added/removed file invalidates the generated `.xcodeproj` (mtime comparison alone is blind to a deletion). `Package.resolved` is deliberately **not** an input — xcodebuild rewrites it on every app build, which would invalidate the test record every time; discard that churn rather than committing it. `make test FILTER=<name>` records nothing (a filtered run proves one test, not the suite). Force with `make -B <target>`.
- **Run the test suite with `make test`**, which dispatches to `swift test`. Xcode 26.6 is the active toolchain, so Swift Testing loads natively and needs no wrapper. Running `swift test` by hand works but writes no `.make/test` record, so the next `make all` re-runs the suite.
- **Building the app with `xcodebuild` needs the SPM macro plugins trusted** (SQLiteData → swift-structured-queries / swift-perception macros). A fresh machine's first `xcodebuild` fails until you trust them — either click **Trust & Enable** when Xcode prompts, or run once (per-machine, not a repo change): `defaults write com.apple.dt.Xcode IDESkipPackagePluginFingerprintValidation -bool YES` and `defaults write com.apple.dt.Xcode IDESkipMacroFingerprintValidation -bool YES`.
- The CLI is an Xcode `tool` target (**target `PensieveCLI`, `PRODUCT_NAME: pensieve`** — renamed to avoid a case-insensitive-filesystem collision with the app target `Pensieve`), embedded and ad-hoc-signed at `Pensieve.app/Contents/Helpers/pensieve`. Build with `make cli`; `make build` uses the app scheme, which also builds and embeds it. **`swift run pensieve` and `swift run PensieveApp` do not exist.** PensieveKit + tests stay SwiftPM; tests honor `PENSIEVE_DB` and `PENSIEVE_CAPTURE_DB` env overrides pointing at temp SQLite files.
- If a build dies with a SwiftSyntax/macro linker error, `rm -rf .build` and retry.
- **Gotcha:** external callers (git hooks, `~/.claude/settings.json`, `claude mcp add`) resolve the CLI via the `~/.local/bin/pensieve` symlink, not a `PATH`-found binary — keep `~/.local/bin` on `PATH` for the bare-token `claude mcp add pensieve` case. The launch-time symlink auto-create runs only from the installed `/Applications` app (guarded off `.build` paths).

## Observability

Structured logging via `os.Logger`, subsystem `me.mazetti.pensieve`. Categories: `sync`, `extraction`, `llm`, `ingest`, `discovery`, `app`.

- **NOTE: `log` is shadowed by a shell function here — prefix these with `/usr/bin/`** or they print nothing and look like "no events".
- **Stream live:** `log stream --predicate 'subsystem == "me.mazetti.pensieve"' --level debug`
- **Recent:** `log show --predicate 'subsystem == "me.mazetti.pensieve"' --last 2h --style compact`
- **Single category:** `log show --predicate 'subsystem == "me.mazetti.pensieve" AND category == "extraction"' --last 1h`
- **MetricKit diagnostics:** `ls ~/Library/Logs/Pensieve/diagnostics/` · **Crash reports:** `ls ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/Pensieve-*.ips`

Full guide with debugging recipes: `docs/observability.md`.

## Architecture (as built)

Two SQLite databases, deliberately separate:
- **Capture spool** (`capture.sqlite`) — dumb, append-only, WAL, never synced. Git hooks / `pensieve capture-*` append one raw row and exit. **The capture path is sacred: fast, fire-and-forget, and must never block or break a git commit.**
- **Canonical store** (`pensieve.sqlite`) — rich model via **SQLiteData (GRDB-backed)**, UUID PKs, STRICT tables. The only store that will ever sync (CloudKit, later).

Derived stores are disposable, rebuildable and never synced: `narration-cache.sqlite`, `search-index.sqlite`, `translation-cache.sqlite`.

Flow: `git hook / CLI → spool → Ingester.drain() → canonical events`. The **ingester** is the only writer of the canonical store; it enriches git commits (via `git show`) and Claude Code sessions (by reading the on-disk `.jsonl` transcripts) into project-attributed `Event`s.

**Core principle — a Project is an area of work, NOT a directory.** Git repos are one *source type* (`SourceKind.gitRepo`); Claude Code sessions another (`SourceKind.claudeCode`). Sources bind many-to-one to a node; `pensieve group` merges. Attribution is by *canonicalized filesystem path → source → node*.

Layout: `Sources/PensieveKit/{Model,Store,Capture,Transcript,Ingest,Intelligence,LLM,Discovery,Daemon,Sync,Search,Translation,Query,Support}` (the framework — all real logic), `Sources/PensieveCLI/` (thin CLI), `Sources/PensieveApp/` (thin SwiftUI app), `Tests/PensieveKitTests/`.

## Conventions & gotchas

- **Name things explicitly — no abbreviations, no single letters.** Write `database`/`node`/`looseEnd`/`event`/`payload`, not `db`/`n`/`le`/`ev`/`p`. The terse names scattered through the codebase are **historical Claude output, not this project's style**; do not treat them as a pattern to match, and do not relax SwiftLint's `identifier_name` rule to accommodate them. Genuine wire-format keys (JSON/MCP `snake_case` such as `node_id`, `max_tokens`) are the one exception and belong behind explicit `CodingKeys` so the Swift property stays camelCase.
- **SwiftLint is enforced in CI (`swiftlint lint --strict`)** with `.swiftlint.yml` at the repo root. Config encodes real conventions; it is not a place to silence findings that should be fixed in code. Note `nesting` (types at most 1 level deep) and the 400-line file cap.
- **SQLiteData predicates use `.eq(x)`, NOT `== x`** (e.g. `.where { $0.name.eq(name) }`). `==` is `unavailable` and won't compile.
- Table/column names must match `@Table` property names exactly; tables are `STRICT`; PKs are `UUID` (keeps CloudKit reachable).
- Kind strings live in `CaptureKind` / `SourceKind` (`CapturePayloads.swift`) — reuse the constants, don't hardcode.
- Don't use a shared mutable `static` `ISO8601DateFormatter` (Swift 6 concurrency); use a local instance or `Date.ISO8601FormatStyle`.
- **No Python, ever.** Swift only.
- **I have a Claude *subscription*, no API key** — go through the `LLMProvider` protocol whose default shells out to `claude -p`. Stay provider-agnostic. (An app-only cloud provider exists for narration; extraction stays on-device.)
- **New LLM-backed tasks must register an `EvalTask`** and get their default model from `pensieve eval` (on-device-first), not a hand-picked constant. See `Sources/PensieveKit/Eval/README.md`. A `registry ↔ config` test fails the suite otherwise.
- **The app (`Sources/PensieveApp/`) has no unit tests** — it's an Xcode app target, not covered by `PensieveKitTests`. Verify with **`make uitest`** and **`make uiprobe`** (see the `verify-app-ui` skill). **Do not "smoke-launch the inner binary" to verify app behaviour — it exercises no app code**, because `AppModel.start()` runs from a `.task` on a rendered view body and a backgrounded direct-exec never renders one. Keep derivation logic (bucketing, tree/card building, ranking) in **tested PensieveKit**; keep views thin. App reads are read-only; the only canonical writer is `Ingester.drain()`.
- **The app is a real `.app` bundle built by XcodeGen + Xcode** — `project.yml` is the source of truth; it defines a macOS app target linking PensieveKit as a local SwiftPM package, ad-hoc signed, deployment target **macOS 26.0** (`Package.swift` stays `.macOS(.v14)`; App-Intents code is app-target-only). The app lands at `./.build-xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Pensieve.app`. `Pensieve.xcodeproj/` and `.build-xcode/` are gitignored; regenerate with `make generate` (required after any branch that adds or removes source files).
- **`Localizable.xcstrings` is hand-authored.** `xcodebuild` does **not** extract keys into it — that is IDE-only. A JSON key must match its Swift literal character-for-character or German silently falls back to English. Verify against the built bundle with `plutil -p …/de.lproj/Localizable.strings`. **Chrome is localized; captured content — node names, quotes, loose-end text, transcripts, event summaries — never is.**

## How we work here

Design-first. For any feature: brainstorm → write a spec/plan under `docs/superpowers/` → execute with review checkpoints (subagent-driven). Surface tradeoffs; keep changes surgical and minimal (YAGNI). Grounded-with-provenance is the north star for the intelligence layer — every AI-surfaced "loose end" must cite real captured text or it doesn't appear.

**Platform primitives first.** Always prefer the first-party / OS-native mechanism over a custom implementation when one exists — SwiftUI `App`/`Scene` lifecycle and `.commands` over a hand-built `NSMenu`, `WindowGroup` restoration over manual frame autosave, Foundation/AppKit facilities over reinvented equivalents. Reach for a custom path only when the native one is proven insufficient, and say why.

**Two paths that are supposed to agree will drift.** This project has been bitten repeatedly (hence `SearchHitResolver`, `EmbeddableCorpus.corpusNodes`, `FindMatcher`). Extract the shared rule into one place rather than restating it.

**Mutation-check your tests.** Vacuous tests have shipped here twice and were caught only by deleting the clause under test and confirming the test goes red. Run the mutation; don't reason about it.
